element.description: The value of this url parameter.

excludeName.description:
Whether or not to exclude this parameter name in the resulting url.  Parameter name is the string value in
{@link UiSdlUrlPayloadSpec#params}. If true the url will contain `paramName/element` otherwise the url will only
contain `element`.

title:
Url Parameter object used by {@link UiSdlUrlPayloadSpec}. Indicates how to generate a param value for a url to use
in UIAsyncEffectRedirect#generateUrl.
name: UiSdlUrlParamSpec
